title: Word Search II
description:
Given an `m x n` board of characters and a list of `words`, return **all words** from the list that can be found on the board.

A word is built from letters of sequentially adjacent cells (horizontal or vertical neighbors), and the same cell may not be used more than once within a single word. You may return the words in any order.
constraints: All words are unique and use lowercase letters.
hints: Running a separate word search for every word is too slow. Put all the words into a trie and search the board once.
While exploring the board, walk down the trie in step; stop a branch as soon as the current path is not a prefix of any word.
